Immigrant Menu Lab — spaghetti and meatballs for Sunday

Every Sunday we make spaghetti and meatballs from scratch in our kitchen.

The spaghetti dough needs farro flour, water, salt and patience to rest overnight.

For the meatballs we mix farro, garlic, egg and pecorino before frying.

We simmer the meatballs in tomato sauce for two hours so they stay juicy.

Our friends Melissa and Leo love the farro meatballs the most at Sunday lunch.

Write to gino@example.com to book an evening at the kitchen table.

The full recipe is at https://example.com/receipt with step-by-step photos.
